description: Save the warehouses one marketplace sells from, after preview_channel_warehouses: send the SAME platform and warehouseIds with that preview's token copied verbatim; a stale, expired or mismatched preview, or a list changed meanwhile, is refused — preview again. Requires settings:write (owner/admin over OAuth or an explicitly scoped token) AND the workspace owner's AI marketplace-writes switch, off by default. Saves and audits the list and queues delivery of the new quantities to the channel at once (Google Merchant takes them at its next run); saving the same list changes nothing. Never moves physical stock, channel membership or armed write directions. Confirm with the person after showing the preview. Echoes the workspace.

platform.description: The marketplace slug from list_marketplaces whose warehouses change; get_stock_sources lists the channels that take a list.

previewToken.description: The previewToken returned by preview_channel_warehouses for the SAME platform and warehouseIds, copied verbatim.

warehouseIds.description: The warehouses the channel sells from, in the order its orders take units: own warehouses or supplier showcases (kind own or supplier in list_warehouses), each once, at most 20. null removes the list, so the channel publishes each product's total again.

name: set_channel_warehouses
title: Set channel warehouses
